verses.html: Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession, Christ Jesus;
verses.text: Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession, Christ Jesus;

verses.html: Who was faithful to him that appointed him, as also Moses was faithful in all his house.
verses.text: Who was faithful to him that appointed him, as also Moses was faithful in all his house.

verses.html: For this man was counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who hath builded the house hath more honour than the house.
verses.text: For this man was counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who hath builded the house hath more honour than the house.

verses.html: For every house is builded by some man; but he that built all things is God.
verses.text: For every house is builded by some man; but he that built all things is God.

verses.html: And Moses verily was faithful in all his house, as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after;
verses.text: And Moses verily was faithful in all his house, as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after;

verses.html: But Christ as a son over his own house; whose house are we, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end.
verses.text: But Christ as a son over his own house; whose house are we, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end.

verses.html: Wherefore (as the Holy Ghost saith, To day if ye will hear his voice,
verses.text: Wherefore (as the Holy Ghost saith, To day if ye will hear his voice,

verses.html: Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the wilderness:
verses.text: Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the wilderness:

verses.html: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my works forty years.
verses.text: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my works forty years.

verses.html: Wherefore I was grieved with that generation, and said, They do alway err in their heart; and they have not known my ways.
verses.text: Wherefore I was grieved with that generation, and said, They do alway err in their heart; and they have not known my ways.

verses.html: So I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.)
verses.text: So I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.)

verses.html: Take heed, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living God.
verses.text: Take heed, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living God.

verses.html: But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.
verses.text: But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.

verses.html: For we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end;
verses.text: For we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end;

verses.html: While it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.
verses.text: While it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.

verses.html: For some, when they had heard, did provoke: howbeit not all that came out of Egypt by Moses.
verses.text: For some, when they had heard, did provoke: howbeit not all that came out of Egypt by Moses.

verses.html: But with whom was he grieved forty years? was it not with them that had sinned, whose carcases fell in the wilderness?
verses.text: But with whom was he grieved forty years? was it not with them that had sinned, whose carcases fell in the wilderness?

verses.html: And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that believed not?
verses.text: And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that believed not?

verses.html: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.
verses.text: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.
